title: VelServe: Taming Decode Jitters in LLM Inference with Tail-Calibrated Scheduling
abstract: arXiv:2611.18392v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Interactive LLM services must meet latency service-level objectives (SLOs) for the time to first token (TTFT) and the time between tokens (TBT), as streaming and soft real-time applications require predictable token delivery. We identify decode jitters in both aggregated and disaggregated serving. A jitter delays every request in the batch, and long responses span hundreds of steps, so even rare overruns cause many SLO violations. In aggregated serving, SLO-aware schedulers set each step's prefill budget until its predicted latency just meets the TBT target, leaving no room for mispredictions or host stalls. Disaggregation meets average TBT targets at a cost in capacity, yet the steps that admit new requests still run late.   We present \sysname, a scheduler that calibrates how much prefill work each decode step carries using the measured tail of its own iteration latency. translated_title: VelServe：通过尾部校准调度驯服大语言模型推理中的解码抖动
translated_abstract: 交互式大语言模型（LLM）服务必须满足针对首令牌时间（TTFT）和令牌间隔时间（TBT）的延迟服务级目标（SLO），因为流式传输和软实时应用需要可预测的令牌交付。我们在聚合式和分离式两种服务架构中都发现了解码抖动现象。一次抖动会延迟批处理中的每一个请求，而长回复跨越数百个解码步骤，因此即使是罕见的超时也会导致大量SLO违规。在聚合式服务中，SLO感知调度器会为每个步骤设定预填充预算，使其预测延迟恰好满足TBT目标，这导致系统没有为预测误差或主机停顿留下任何余地。分离式架构虽然以牺牲容量为代价满足了平均TBT目标，但接纳新请求的步骤仍然会延迟完成。我们提出了VelServe，一种利用解码步骤自身迭代延迟的实测尾部数据来校准每个步骤所承载预填充工作量的调度器。SLO决定了延迟步骤需要多么罕见，VelServe学习……
tldr: VelServe通过利用解码步骤自身迭代延迟的实测尾部数据来动态校准每步的预填充工作量，有效驯服LLM推理中的解码抖动，从而满足TTFT和TBT的延迟服务级目标。
en_tdlr: VelServe tames decode jitters in LLM inference by calibrating the prefill work carried by each decode step using the measured tail of its own iteration latency, thereby meeting TTFT and TBT latency SLOs.
